claims.text: Each line's yearly cost is exact: week amounts times 52, month amounts times 12, year amounts as typed.
Each line's monthly cost is its yearly cost divided by 12 and rounded half up to the cent, once per line.
The total per year and the total per month are plain sums of the line figures, to the cent.
Lines are listed biggest yearly cost first, and equal costs keep the typed order.
Blank and zero lines are left out, so nothing is invented for them.
The questions to ask before a call are generic. They hold no prices, offers or advice.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the line.
